name: Kotor
point: Point of treatment or disposal (Landfill, dumpsite, incinerator, composting plant)

references.source: Montenegro data for Sustainable Development Goal indicators. 2021. "Indicator 11.6.1 Proportion of municipal solid waste collected and managed in controlled facilities out of total municipal waste generated, by cities" Sustainable Development Goals. https://www.sdgmontenegro.me/en/11-6-1/
references.point: Point of treatment or disposal (Landfill, dumpsite, incinerator, composting plant)
references.notes: Tonnage of collected waste is equal to the treated tonnage (14216).

references.source: Sad, Novi. 2015. "REPORT ON QUANTITIES AND MORPHOLOGICAL COMPOSITION OF WASTE FOR 16 REPRESENTATIVE MUNICIPALITIES"
references.method: Waste characterisation (compositional analysis) with stratified sample
references.notes: In the source referenced, there is a table with a MSW composition for three different groups (collective housing, individual housing and rural sector). The composition for individual housing and rural sector did not sum to 100% and were rebased. The average for the three groups was then calculated to give the MSW composition for each material. The source states this category as other biodegradable waste.
references.collectionNotes: Samples were taken from all three zones (collective housing, individual housing and rural sector). Streets were selcted for each household type.
